args.content:
# Summary

- monday.md: the demo moves to Friday 14:00; Alice prepares the slides; Bob cleans the dataset.
- tuesday.md: Bob finished the dataset (1,204 rows); the demo is said to be on Thursday 10:00.
- wednesday.md: Alice's slides are drafted; a projector is still needed for the demo room.

## Contradictions

- Demo time: monday.md says Friday 14:00, tuesday.md says Thursday 10:00 "as planned". Nobody was available to confirm which one is right.

args.check: 1) summary.md exists: fs_write reported writing it. 2) It has one line for each of monday.md, tuesday.md and wednesday.md. 3) Its Contradictions section names the Friday 14:00 vs Thursday 10:00 demo conflict, the only conflict found.

reflect.lesson: There are three notes: monday.md, tuesday.md, wednesday.md.
Monday: the demo moved to Friday 14:00; Alice does the slides; Bob cleans the data.
Tuesday says the demo is on Thursday 10:00, which contradicts Monday's Friday 14:00.
reflect.calibration: The format was as expected, but I did not anticipate a contradiction.

reflect.lesson: Nobody can confirm the date, so the summary should report the conflict instead of choosing a side.
Wednesday: the slides are drafted and a projector is still needed.
The goal was closed after checking each criterion.
